heading.text: AI Agent Development FAQs

a: An AI agent is software powered by a large language model that can work towards a goal on its own. Instead of only answering questions, it plans the steps, uses tools such as your CRM, email or database, and completes tasks, asking a person for approval when needed.

items.q: How is an AI agent different from a chatbot?
a: A chatbot mainly answers questions in a conversation. An AI agent can also take action: it looks up information, updates records, sends messages and runs multi-step workflows across your business systems.

items.q: What can AI agents automate for my business?
a: Common examples are customer support, lead qualification, appointment booking, data entry, document processing, report generation and internal knowledge search. We start by finding the tasks that take your team the most time.

items.q: Which platforms and models do you use to build AI agents?
a: We work with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and Llama models, frameworks such as LangChain, and automation tools such as n8n. We choose the model and stack that fit your use case, budget and data requirements.

items.q: How much does AI agent development cost?
a: It depends on what the agent needs to do, how many systems it connects to and how much data it uses. After a free consultation we recommend a scope and share a fixed-price quote, or you can hire a dedicated AI team on a monthly or hourly basis.

items.q: Is my business data safe with an AI agent?
a: We give each agent access only to the data and tools it needs, add human approval for sensitive actions and log what it does. Agents can also run in your own cloud account so your data stays under your control.
